messages:
Marco: heads-up — we saw ~120 leads this morning sit unassigned for 8+ mins because enrichment webhook timed out. need a short tactical fix before Monday. :grimacing:
Anya: ugh. is this the HubSpot enrichment lambda? or the SF sync?
Marco: enrichment lambda timed out calling the enrichment service (3xx/5xx spikes). HS still has the record in 'Awaiting Enrichment' stage so no owner assigned.
Sam: can we fallback to a default SDR pool after X seconds? customers hate long handoff delays. :eyes:
Devon: +1 to fallback. suggest 30s grace then assign to "inbound-temp-pool" and mark lead note: "auto-fallback due to enrich timeout"
Anya: agree. also we should increment a counter tag so we can measure how often fallback occurs.
Lina: quick ask — do we want the fallback in HubSpot workflow or at the insertion point (our webhook)? pros/cons: workflow change is slower to iterate, webhook change is fast but touches infra.
Marco: prefer webhook change for fast rollout, but will pair with a small HS workflow so the UI shows fallback reason.
Anya: sounds good. Proposed webhook pseudo-config:
```
if enrichment_not_complete_after(30s):
  assign_owner('inbound-temp-pool')
  add_contact_property('enrich_fallback','webhook-30s')
  emit_metric('lead.fallback.v1')
```
Sam: please also add a retry for enrich call (1 retry after 500ms) so we don't double-fallback on flakey networks.
Lina: implemented retry logic in staging earlier today. will add the 30s timer + metric emit. I'll push a patch to staging now and drop the endpoint URL in #eng-platform for testing.
Devon: how do we prevent dupes in SFDC when fallback owner is applied? we had mapping issues last quarter.
Anya: we'll add a flag property "fallback_owner_applied" that our SF sync ignores for owner overwrite if the contact already has an owner in SF. mapping logic: only push owner if sfdc_owner is null OR force_owner=true.
HS Bot: webhook event received: contact.12345 enrichment_status=timeout (simulated)
Marco: action items: Lina deploy webhook patch to staging (Lina), Anya update SF sync rule to respect fallback flag (Anya), Devon run a canary with weekend subset (Devon), Sam validate SDR queue handling (Sam). aim for production patch Monday morning PST if canary is clean.
Sam: I'll validate queue and look for owner churn alerts. will also add a short confluence note for SDRs explaining the new auto-fallback behaviour.
Devon: I'll run a 200-lead synthetic test against staging tomorrow at 10am PT and report fallback metrics.
Lina: patch merged to staging (PR: https://git.redwood/infra/1234). test endpoint: https://staging.hub-webhook.redwood/enrich-fallback. will ping here when warm.
Anya: I'll prepare an alert in Datadog: alert when fallback rate > 2% for > 15m and also create a dashboard tile for average assignment latency.
Marco: perfect. after prod deploy let's snapshot a short playbook: when enrich timeouts spike -> increase retry to 2, extend fallback to 60s for heavy batch windows, and open an incident if fallback > 5% sustained.
Sam: :thumbsup: would like a one-liner we can paste into SDR slack so they're not surprised.
Marco: one-liner: "If enrichment fails, leads auto-assign to temporary inbound pool after 30s; SDRs: workflow will update note 'auto-fallback' — no duplicate SF owner changes."
Devon: ready to run canary tomorrow. tagging @Sam to confirm queue readiness.
Sam: confirmed. I'll be on deck at 10am.
Marco: thanks team — will follow up with a short confluence playbook and add the update to Monday stand. :rocket:
